trainingProvenance.split: Deterministic seeded 80% train / 20% held-out test; generated samples are IID synthetic scenarios, not chronological field telemetry

evaluationLimitations.note: Curves and subgroup metrics describe held-out synthetic samples only; they are not real-world performance estimates.

evaluated.name: Isolation Forest
evaluated.rationale: Effective multi-sensor isolation without label bias; sub-millisecond inference.

evaluated.name: Neural Autoencoder
evaluated.rationale: Non-linear bottleneck representation provides per-sensor residual attribution.

evaluated.name: Physics-Informed Hybrid
evaluated.rationale: Directly enforces CEMA 7th Edition / ISO 5048 physical boundary constraints.

evaluated.name: TSPulse
evaluated.rationale: Incompatible with 0.5Hz tabular telemetry; requires high-frequency acoustic pulse data and PyTorch runtime.

evaluated.name: TCNs
evaluated.rationale: High tensor complexity in pure Node.js; Autoencoder and Isolation Forest provide superior anomaly performance.

evaluated.name: PatchTST & IBM TinyTimeMixer
evaluated.rationale: Predict future sensor trajectories rather than failure events; heavy PyTorch/Granite dependency.

evaluated.name: YOLOv8/11-seg
evaluated.rationale: Requires annotated conveyor polygon segmentation dataset and GPU runtime; not available in current codebase.

evaluated.name: RT-DETR
evaluated.rationale: Requires annotated tramp iron/foreign object dataset and transformer vision runtime.
